items.title: George Pickens: Career-high totals in return
items.text:
Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Weak showing in loss to Carolina
items.text:
Shough completed 25 of 35 targets for 187 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added 25 rushing yards on six carries and was charged with a lost fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Olave: Overshadowed by rookie in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Olave caught three of four targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Career-high receiving yardage tally in win
items.text:
McCaffrey rushed 13 times for 62 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 161 yards and two more scores in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also caught a two-point conversion pass.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bryce Young: Does just enough to eke out win
items.text:
Young completed 17 of 30 passes for 200 yards without a touchdown or interception in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. He added one rushing yard on his only carry.
